name: Outback Core Molten
description: Those on the frontier know that survival is paramount. The tough and lived-in Outback Armor is hewn from reinforced leather, with a thick hooded cowl neck and layered skirting. With the necessary gear, there's no guarantee that you'll live to see another day, but now you've got a fighting chance. The Molten version is dyed a deep red to keep you subtle, but not unsightly.
